CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates maintained by hoody424.
- **MeshCentral**: self-hosted remote management (remote desktop, terminal, files), official image ghcr.io/ylianst/meshcentral. - **OpenVPN Access Server**: official image openvpn/openvpn-as. - **psono**: self-hosted password manager server, psono/psono-server.
Each app links its support page. Template problems can also go to https://github.com/hoody424/unraid-templates/issues.
